answer: The meadow chain is verified at intake and sparrow publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a forge checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 5 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
